description: Use this when someone asks for their Indu Lagna, their money or wealth sign, or which planet is key for money in their Vedic chart ("indu lagna calculator", "my wealth sign in astrology", "which planet brings me money"). Returns the money sign and its house, how it is counted (the 9th lords and their kalas), the planets in it and aspecting it, the money point’s nakshatra and the key planet for money. It is a Jaimini method used widely by astrologers today, not in the classical texts our readings are checked against: call it a method. Never promise wealth or a sum. Needs birth date, time and town.

birth_place.description: Town or city of birth, with region or country if known, e.g. "Chicago, Illinois, US" or "Pune, India".

birth_time.description: Local clock time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 13:35. As exact as possible (from a birth certificate).
